cohort: The study included women undergoing second- and third-trimester pregnancy termination or induction for intrauterine fetal death (IUFD) at a Canadian tertiary hospital between 2017 and 2019.
finding: The mifepristone-misoprostol protocol significantly reduced the median time to expulsion and the total misoprostol dose, with fewer reported adverse effects and similar complication rates, compared to misoprostol alone.
